B ⇒ A only vacuously: A's claims are about an abstract ii and the project's path space; they are re-proved outright from non-item project lemmas (isClopen_windSet, norm_cdet, cdet_exp, disjoint_windSet, IsAngleLift.unique, clifford_simp).
